visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and a black t-shirt is holding a large, green and white patterned triangular gift box. He has a joyful expression with his mouth open. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall with soft studio lighting. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up top-down view of the opened gift box. Inside, there are several beauty products neatly arranged: a silver lipstick tube, a silver compact, a black tube, a small black stuffed doll wearing a hat, and a triangular pink perfume bottle. The setting is bright and clean. (3) The man holds up the small black doll. It is wearing a black puffer-style jacket with a silver zipper and a bucket hat with a white triangle logo. He smiles at the camera, holding the doll in front of him. The background remains the same neutral wall. (4) He then showcases individual items: a black mascara tube with silver lettering, a silver lip balm case, and the triangular glass perfume bottle filled with pink liquid. He holds each item close to the camera, rotating them slightly to show the texture and branding. (5) He holds an eye shadow palette, opening the gold-rimmed case to reveal four shades: a light peach, a deep reddish-brown, a shimmering silver, and a dark brown. He uses a small applicator brush to apply the reddish-brown shade to his right eyelid. (6) A series of close-ups show the application process. He uses a blending brush to soften the edges of the eye shadow. Then, he applies a darker shade to the outer corner and a lighter shimmer to the inner corner. Text overlays and small diagram images of the eye makeup appear on the screen. (7) He applies mascara to his eyelashes and lip balm to his lips. He smiles and poses, showing the completed look. Finally, he sprays the perfume near his neck, closing his eyes and tilting his head back to suggest enjoyment of the scent. He concludes by waving the small doll.
